description.value: A boutique apartment-style hotel spread across two riverfront buildings in Steveston Village, a historic fishing village where the Fraser River meets the Pacific Ocean. Suites range from studios to three-bedroom layouts, each with a fully equipped kitchen and contactless digital-key check-in via a guest portal. Its location in the heart of Steveston puts cyclists steps from the waterfront and the village's renowned seafood dining scene.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for the listing. The FAQ confirms Wi-Fi is included in all stays, the Suites page confirms in-suite laundry is available in select suite types, and the Contact/FAQ pages confirm a secure underground parkade with digital key access — but no mention of dedicated bike storage. Phone number (604) 424-4972 and Port Building address 4280 Bayview St match OSM exactly; the website also lists a second building at 4300 Bayview St not in OSM.
concerns: Hotel occupies two buildings (Port: 4280 Bayview St; Starboard: 4300 Bayview St) but OSM records only the Port Building address. The second building at 4300 Bayview St is not in the OSM record.
Secure underground parkade is mentioned (digital key, onsite) but it is described in the context of vehicle parking only; no dedicated or mentioned bike storage was found on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable boutique hotel in Steveston Village with a fully operational website; clearly open and accessible to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Kitchen-equipped apartment suites and in-suite laundry in select rooms make this a strong option for multi-night touring stays. The secure parkade uses a digital key code issued via the guest portal — worth inquiring whether bikes can also be stored there.

Laundry.detail: In-suite laundry available in select suite types including the Studio; confirmed on Suites page ('In-suite Laundry*' with asterisk denoting some suite types) and Extended Stays page ('many include in-suite laundry')

wow_evidence: boutique apartment-style hotel in Steveston Village, a historic fishing village where the Fraser River meets the Pacific Ocean
